title: Surface Electromyographic Activation Patterns and Elbow Joint Motion During a Pull-Up, Chin-Up, or Perfect-Pullup Rotational Exercise
journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research
population: Adults performing pull-up and chin-up variants

keyFinding.enGB: Pull-up and chin-up variants show distinct surface EMG and elbow-motion patterns useful for coaching grip choices.
keyFinding.uk: Варіанти підтягувань прямим і зворотним хватом мають різні патерни поверхневої ЕМГ і руху ліктя, корисні для вибору хвату.

evidenceGrade.rationale: Observational EMG/kinematics; not long-term outcome data.

limitations: Commercial rotational bar named in original title is not an OmniGart product endorsement
